changes: Taps are now placed by time of day: morning taps in the A.M. boxes, afternoon taps in the P.M. boxes (e.g. 7:00 and 5:00 → A.M. Arrival and P.M. Departure).
Double taps within 5 minutes are counted once; one tap is treated as a time in.
Reads more biometric files: Monthly Punch Report, Monthly Statement Report, Employee Attendance Table and more device logs.
Prefer the old way? Settings → General → How taps fill the time boxes.
